senses.gloss: अव्रतिक अव्रतिक, i. e. अ-व्रत + इक, adj. One who neglects his religious duties, Indr. 2, 5.
अ- + व्रण अ- + व्रण, adj. 1. without any fracture, Man. 2, 47. 2. without a wound or perceivable injury, Suśr. 2, 311, 13(?).
अ- + व्रत अ- + व्रत, adj. one who does not observe the rules of his order, Man. 3, 170.
